The `get_plain_text()` function essentially performs an all-reduce on the relevant tensor. This requires all the processes (except the TTP, if it exists) to participate in the communication, that is, all parties must agree to share their secret share of the tensor. If one party calls `get_plain_text()` but the other parties do not, then that party's process will simply halt forever (because it is waiting for the other parties to call `get_plain_text()` as well).
